provenance.mi10Inputs: commandGame and updateGame only; no position, health, clock, damage or mission-state setters in the MI10 driver
provenance.regressionScope: Existing engine unit tests are a separate scope and retain their own controlled fixtures.

assertions: Three locally inspected tanks and a separately copied material registry
Twenty seconds of active sampling from a surviving source and apparatus
Private force presence only after sample, demolition or source-loss event plus a five-second arrival delay
PT02 requires sample, all three material markings and copied Orison record; copied evidence survives later original destruction
Mass conserved per scene across tank stocks, collected sample, pending leak and all retained/travelling/delivered plumes
Canal exposure reconciles from deposits and survives covering, reopening and later damage
Every chassis can cover the first canal upstream before any contact loads it; actual feet then use the raised surface
Early source loss, active sampler destruction, unread originals lost, pollution, canal rupture and terminal walker defeat are preserved
An input frame opening a decision advances physical material to the exact saved clock, then pause is exact
JSON continuation reproduces anchored work, active sampling/combat and material transit exactly
New post-report spills lock extraction until their actual arrival; transmitted report remains an historical act
limits: Simulation prototype only; no native-browser or human reception follows from these tests.
Units are game material quantities and world coordinates, with no physical unit conversion claimed.
Captured matter stays in a separate retention basin; opening or breaking the diversion valve changes later flow without draining that basin.
Canal covers support feet and protect structure; they do not remove chemical exposure.
Village habitat conditions are physical statuses, not an invented population census.
The sample loss is an objective failure that can be recorded in a completed mission without creating PT02.
